function.name: reqmap_init
function.description: First-use bootstrap: scaffold requirements/ and .reqmapignore if missing, draft requirements from existing code/prose, build the lock and map, and print guided next steps. Idempotent — safe to re-run; never clobbers an existing .reqmapignore. Run once per repo to get started.

working_directory.description: Repo root where requirements/ should live. Defaults to cwd.

function.name: reqmap_gate
function.description: Run the commit/CI gate (report-only): verify every code tag resolves to a real requirement, every confirmed requirement has at least one implements: member, and drift has not been introduced since the last sync. Exits non-zero on link-sync errors only (drift and test-link integrity are warnings). Never touches _reqlock.json. Run before every commit and in CI.

strict.description: Promote drift and test-link integrity warnings to errors (--strict). Useful in CI when all requirements are confirmed.

json.description: Emit structured JSON output instead of human-readable text.

since.description: Limit gate to requirements touched since this git ref (e.g. 'main', 'HEAD~1').

function.name: reqmap_sync
function.description: Rescan code members, advance the drift baseline, and regenerate the map in one step. Run after editing requirement files or tagging new code members. Use accept_drift when a confirmed or implemented contract changed.

accept_drift.description: Explicitly advance the baseline when a confirmed or implemented contract changed (--accept-drift). Required by sync when those contracts differ from the lock; sync exits non-zero without it.

function.name: reqmap_map
function.description: Generate requirements/_map.md (4 Mermaid diagrams), requirements/_map.json (graph with nodes, edges, todos), and requirements/_map.html (a self-contained double-click-openable React viewer with 4 tabs: Map, Problems, Spec, Roadmap). The viewer is only emitted when scripts/_map_viewer.html is vendored beside the engine.

check.description: Freshness gate: rebuild the map in memory and exit non-zero if the committed _map.* is stale (--check). Use in CI alongside gate.

function.name: reqmap_new
function.description: Scaffold a new blank requirement from the built-in template. Use from_todo and id together to pre-fill from a TODO.md item instead.

id.description: Requirement ID in AREA-NAME-NNN format (e.g. AUTH-LOGIN-001). Required unless using from_todo.

from_todo.description: Name of a TODO.md item to pre-fill the requirement from (--from-todo). Requires id.

mark_done.description: Flip the TODO.md item to [x] at the same time (--mark-done). Only used with from_todo.

function.name: reqmap_confirm
function.description: Mark a reviewed requirement as confirmed — the human sign-off step. Flips status to confirmed in the frontmatter. The engine refuses if the requirement has no implements: member (a confirmed requirement must point to code). Run sync after confirming.

function.name: reqmap_draft
function.description: Draft one requirement per untagged file (code and prose). Input is existing untagged source code and Markdown. Emits draft requirements — never confirmed. After drafting, run gate and report the result. Remind the user to review and confirm the real ones.

function.name: reqmap_plan
function.description: Read-only JSON capability-extraction plan: emit a capability map from legacy code without writing any .md files. Safer than draft — a human authors and confirms each candidate. Use before draft to preview what would be extracted.

md_glob.description: Additional glob patterns for non-code Markdown to include in the plan (e.g. ['prompts/**', 'modes/**']).

function.name: reqmap_next
function.description: Show what to do next: a prioritized, actionable list of risk buckets (Orphans, Needs tests, Needs intent review, Drafts to review). Read-only, always exits 0. The best follow-up command to run after any action.

all.description: Expand all buckets to show every item instead of just the top few (--all).

function.name: reqmap_lint
function.description: Readability and structure check on non-draft requirements: long sentences (>35 words), stacked conditions (3+ and/or joins on a shall/must line), missing Contract or Acceptance sections. Read-only; exit-neutral by default.

strict.description: Exit non-zero on error-severity findings only (warnings remain advisory).

function.name: reqmap_show
function.description: Print a consolidated dossier for one requirement: header, intent, Contract bullets, dependencies in both directions, code members grouped by role with file:line, open Verify intent questions, and risk signals. Answers 'what does this do / where is X' in one command. Read-only.

function.name: reqmap_scan
function.description: List which code files belong to which requirement, grouped by capability. Shows all code members (implements:, generated-from:, validated-against:, tested-by:) discovered by scanning the repo.

function.name: reqmap_dupes
function.description: Flag requirement pairs whose contracts overlap (TF-IDF cosine similarity), so a divergent re-implementation is caught before it lands. Read-only, advisory — a human decides if a flagged pair is a real duplicate.

threshold.description: Similarity threshold (0–1). Default 0.35. Lower = more pairs flagged.

function.name: reqmap_health
function.description: Print a corpus coherence snapshot: a headline score (percentage of requirements fully green on every axis: confirmed + member + tested + no open questions + not drifted) plus component counts. Use for a CI badge with json=true.

json.description: Emit parseable JSON for a CI badge (--json).

function.name: reqmap_export
function.description: Write requirements/_map.json (the graph with engine_version, nodes, edges) for feeding an external front-end. Same output as map, without rebuilding _map.md and _map.html.

out.description: Output path override. Use '-' for stdout (--out -).

function.name: reqmap_findings
function.description: Aggregate open 'Verify intent' items across all requirements into requirements/_findings.md. Surfaces every open human-review question in one place.

function.name: reqmap_review
function.description: Emit a JSON review plan (intent, contract, acceptance criteria, structural anchors) for all requirements or one. Used as an AI feed for semantic quality review. Read-only.

id.description: Optional requirement ID to review just one (e.g. AUTH-LOGIN-001). Omit for the whole corpus.

function.name: reqmap_site
function.description: Inject or refresh engine-owned regions (nav links + stats counts) into a project presentation page. Scaffolds a full page if the target does not exist. Run after map to keep the page current.

attach.description: Path to the HTML page to inject regions into (--attach path/to/page.html).

regions.description: Comma-separated list of regions to inject: 'nav' (top links) or 'nav,stats' (links + counts). Default: nav,stats.

diagram.description: Relative path to an Excalidraw .html viewer to link from the nav region.

detect.description: Scan docs/ and suggest the command to run — does not modify any files.
